# Repository for AI Notes

A personal research/experiment repository about AI coding tool configurations and tooling.

## Folder Structure

An overview of the top-level subfolders, organized by purpose.
Individual lists of plugins/skills are covered in each folder's own README or catalog (not covered by this README).

### Config/Plugin Roots per AI Tool

Mapping between the config folder read by each AI coding tool and the folder holding the actual plugins.
For the same tool, the "config the tool reads" (starts with `.`) and the "actual plugins" (`*-plugins/`) are sometimes separate.

- **Claude Code**
  - [.claude/](.claude/) — Settings for developing this repository itself with Claude Code (rules, skills, hooks, scripts, workflows, etc.)
  - [claude-plugins/](claude-plugins/) — Actual Claude Code plugins
  - [.claude-plugin/](.claude-plugin/) — Marketplace definition (`marketplace.json`) and skill catalog (`skill-catalog.json`) that bundle the plugins above

- **Cline**
  - [.cline/](.cline/) — Cline settings (rules, skills)
  - [.clinerules/](.clinerules/) — Rule files read by Cline (`root.md`, `tools-*.md`, `templates.md`, etc.). See `.clinerules/root.md` for details
  - [cline-plugins/](cline-plugins/) — Cline plugins (mainly custom tools)

- **Codex**
  - [codex-plugins/](codex-plugins/) — Codex plugins (settings/skills under `meta/`)
  - [.agents/](.agents/) — Marketplace definition read by Codex (`.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`), which loads plugins such as `copilot-plugins/`. Named `_agents/` to avoid a folder-name clash with Antigravity (see `.agents/README.md`)

- **GitHub Copilot**
  - [copilot-plugins/](copilot-plugins/) — Copilot plugins (docs/skills under `meta/`)
  - [.github/](.github/) — Copilot settings (`copilot/settings.json`), instructions, agents/skills (loaded via plugins), and CI GitHub Actions workflows

- **Cursor**
  - [cursor-plugins/](cursor-plugins/) — Cursor plugins (`.cursor-plugin`, docs, skills under `meta/`)

- **Antigravity**
  - [antigravity-plugins/](antigravity-plugins/) — Root for Antigravity plugins (actual files under `_agents/plugins/`)
  - [_agents/](_agents/) — Storage location for Antigravity plugins (`_agents/plugins/`). Distinguished from `.agents/` (see `_agents/README.md`)

### Repository Operations & Development Support

- [meta-plugins/](meta-plugins/) — Claude Code plugin for maintaining this repository itself (e.g., regeneration steps for generated files). Not a distributable skill but repository-specific, so it is excluded from the marketplace/skill publishing site and from `ai-tools.yaml`. See [meta-plugins/README.md](meta-plugins/README.md) for details.
- [tools/](tools/) — Convenience tools supporting repository management/operations. Main subfolders:
  - `aim/`, `aim-use/` — Model invocation CLI and related tools
  - `claude-wrapper/`, `cline-wrapper/`, `codex-wrapper/`, `cursor-wrapper/` — Wrappers for each AI tool
  - `interactive-cli-wrapper/` — A generic wrapper that drives interactive (TTY-based REPL) CLIs over a PTY
  - `get-settings/` — Settings retrieval helper
  - `infra/` — Infra usage tools (AI log management, etc.)
  - `sandbox/` — Issue-driven Docker sandbox agent (a mechanism that polls for `@sandbox` mentions on GitHub issues and has the Claude Agent SDK do the work)
  - `internal/` — Internal tools such as marketplace/skill catalog generation
- [docs/integrations/](docs/integrations/) — Guides for bringing this repository's plugins and CLI tools into your own environment. CLI install recipes live in `docs/integrations/justfile`. `skill-tools` itself is [tools/skill-tools/](tools/skill-tools/).
- [templates/](templates/) — Template examples for introducing rules/skills etc. all at once (`cline_best/`, `planner/`, etc.)
- [.vscode/](.vscode/) — Example VSCode settings for AI coding tools

### Temporary / Other

- [temp/](temp/) — Temporary working folder (gitignored, not committed)

### Skill Publishing Site

- [skills-site/](skills-site/) — Collects skills from registered AI coding tools across the repository and publishes them as an Astro static site. See [skills-site/README.md](skills-site/README.md) for how to add publishing targets, frontmatter, and the generation/verification steps. The site only publishes the skill body/metadata/distribution ZIPs, not the entire repository.

## Other

- `lefthook.yml` — Git hooks configuration that runs on commit, etc. (various regeneration/formatting/secretlint on `pre-commit`, commitlint on `commit-msg`).
- `mise.toml` — Tool version management via [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/) (pins node / pnpm / terraform / uv for this repository).
- `pyproject.toml` — Root definition of the uv workspace (manages Python packages such as `tools/aim` together).
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` / `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` — Root definition of the pnpm workspace (`skills-site`, `tools/cline-wrapper`) and its lockfile.
- `.prettierrc.json` / `.prettierignore` — Formatting settings.
- `commitlint.config.js` — Lint settings for commit messages ([Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), `@commitlint/config-conventional`).
- `.secretlintrc.json` — Secret detection settings for staged files ([secretlint](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint) `@secretlint/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`).
- `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` — Repository-wide instruction files for each AI tool (describing the same overall structure as the README).

  Resource creation for Azure Static Web Apps is managed via Bicep in [skills-site/infra/](skills-site/infra/); normal publish updates happen through GitHub Actions on push to main. Local verification/Azure operations use the `justfile` at the repository root.
